ref: ADR-0006 Consequences, SUPPRESS through the context functions since #51 (assumed): formatByExample keeps SUPPRESS as a slot with its bit; the SUPPRESS comes from createIf, true for 1 or true in any case and SUPPRESS for anything else (fn/createIf/002); observation #61
note: createIf over Tag in context Orders gives SUPPRESS, "", ""; Sku in context Order cuts after two slots. The first context, SUPPRESS, "", is the one the root's slot reads: one empty All. A SUPPRESS written as a value, or no cut, gives two.
